messages_member_step_key.name: messages_member_step_key
messages_member_step_key.where: "messages"."campaign_member_id" is not null and "messages"."campaign_step_id" is not null

suppression_email_live_key.name: suppression_email_live_key
suppression_email_live_key.where: "suppression_list"."scope" = 'EMAIL' and "suppression_list"."removed_at" is null and "suppression_list"."normalized_email" is not null

suppression_domain_live_key.name: suppression_domain_live_key
suppression_domain_live_key.where: "suppression_list"."scope" = 'DOMAIN' and "suppression_list"."removed_at" is null and "suppression_list"."normalized_domain" is not null
